messages.content: how many mla and mp seats in telangana

message.content:
Telangana has **119 MLAs** in its Legislative Assembly.[1][2][4]

For **MPs**, Telangana has **17 Lok Sabha seats**, so it elects **17 MPs** to the Lok Sabha. The state also has **7 Rajya Sabha seats**, but those members are not directly elected by voters; they are elected by the state legislature.[4]
